hooks.command:
in=$(cat); cmd=$(printf %s "$in" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); case "$cmd" in *"git commit"*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) || exit 0; reason=""; for gate in go-review-gate docs-gate; do out=$("$root/scripts/gates/$gate.sh") || reason="$reason$out

"; done; [ -n "$reason" ] || exit 0; jq -cn --arg r "$reason" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:$r}}'
